origine_fr: Le trou 穴 : regarder en cachette. Dessous, 规 donnait le son ; il se lit guī et ne garde que la fin, -uī. Regarder par un trou, c'est épier, 窥视.
origine_en: A hole, 穴: looking in secret. Below, 规 gave the sound; it is read guī and keeps only the ending, -uī. Looking through a hole is peeping, 窥视.

phrase.pinyin: Yǒu rén zài chuāng wài tōukuī.
phrase.en: Someone is peeping in from outside the window.
